name: tags
summary: Organization tags with palette colors that other modules' resources can carry.
description: Adds a tag starter: organization owners and admins create tags (unique names ignoring case, a fixed palette of color tokens, a short description) and attach up to 20 of them to any resource whose module registers a resource type; every member reads tags, a resource's tags, and the resources carrying a tag. Assignments are replaced idempotently, writes use optimistic concurrency (If-Match), and audit records tag IDs and names but never descriptions. Ships with no resource types; modules register theirs at assembly time without the tag module importing them.
use_when: the team needs labels, tags, or categories on its records
members must filter or group resources by organization-defined tags
another module or plugin needs a shared, product-neutral way to label its resources
